title: Establish Haruspex IP provenance inventory

problem.summary: Haruspex has public source history but no durable chain-of-title inventory or publication gate.
problem.current_behavior: Repository history records publication but omits private creation evidence, ownership unknowns, and a pre-publication provenance review.
problem.desired_outcome: Preserve a verifiable private evidence inventory while publishing only substantiated, non-sensitive provenance metadata.
success_metrics: A private ledger records known facts, evidence hashes, and explicit unknowns.
A full-history bundle is hash-verified against the public repository.
Public metadata makes no unsupported ownership or licensing claims.
Future publication is blocked when provenance review is incomplete.

included: public-safe copyright, contributor, and third-party metadata
full-history Git bundle and SHA-256 evidence index
excluded: storage of contracts, credentials, privileged communications, or confidential employer material in Git

constraints: Unknown facts remain unknown and must not be inferred from Git authorship.
Sensitive records remain outside the public Haruspex repository.
No repository history is rewritten or deleted.
GitHub writes use the pxm-0 identity.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Repository-local provenance controls are initialized and structurally valid.
Public metadata contains only substantiated facts and retains no-license status pending review.
A private ledger and hash-verified full-history archive exist under pxm-0 control.
Automated checks reject missing evidence hashes, unsupported certainty, and sensitive paths.

assumptions.statement: GitHub and local Git metadata may be recorded as publication evidence but not proof of legal ownership.
assumptions.basis: Repository inspection and the limits of Git metadata.
assumptions.impact_if_false: The ledger could overstate chain-of-title evidence.
assumptions.validation: Label every Git-derived claim by evidence type and retain legal ownership as unknown.

assumptions.statement: Employment, assigned-duty, contributor, and copied-material facts are not available in this workspace.
assumptions.basis: Repository and attachment inspection found no underlying contracts or private evidence.
assumptions.impact_if_false: Available evidence could be omitted from the first ledger snapshot.
assumptions.validation: Record the fields as unknown with an owner and follow-up rather than asserting a favorable answer.
assumptions.resolution: For this implementation, unavailable legal facts are recorded as unknown and explicitly excluded from ownership claims; counsel review remains a follow-up.

dependencies: future access to contracts and independently controlled backup storage

failure_modes.scenario: Sensitive legal or employment information is published in the public repository.
failure_modes.mitigation: Store only references and hashes in the private ledger; never store underlying sensitive files in Git.

failure_modes.scenario: Git identity is presented as conclusive proof of authorship or ownership.
failure_modes.mitigation: Separate observed facts from claimed ownership and legal conclusions.

failure_modes.scenario: The only archive is lost or changed.
failure_modes.mitigation: Create a full-history bundle and retain a two-location backup follow-up.

product.rationale: Outcome is evidence preservation, not a title determination.

behavior_ux.rationale: Primary paths are inventory creation, validation failure, and recovery from missing evidence.

data_state.rationale: Known, unknown, evidence, and hash states are explicit and append-only.

security_privacy.rationale: Public/private separation and a sensitive-content denylist are required.

reliability.rationale: Archive verification and reproducible hashes cover corruption and drift.

operations.rationale: The ledger includes review dates, owners, and follow-ups.

performance_cost.rationale: Small repository and standard-library validation have negligible cost.

delivery_release.rationale: Draft PR, issues, private ledger, archive, and pre-publication checks define delivery.

maintainability.rationale: Flat YAML records and one validator avoid a new service or dependency.

external_writes.rationale: GitHub writes are scoped to pxm-0 and verified before mutation.

uses_ai.rationale: AI assistance is recorded as unknown in detail and never treated as human authorship proof.

handles_sensitive_data.rationale: Underlying sensitive documents are excluded from Git; only hashes and references are allowed.

ip_provenance_sensitive.rationale: Publication requires creator, contributor, third-party, AI, confidentiality, licensing, and evidence review.

user_facing.rationale: No runtime user interface is changed.

destructive_operations.rationale: History and evidence deletion are excluded.

scheduled_or_async.rationale: No scheduled or asynchronous runtime is added.

integration: Validate private ledger records and archive hashes.
e2e: Clone the private ledger and verify the referenced Haruspex bundle.
manual: Confirm public files contain no contract text, credentials, privileged communications, or unsupported ownership claim.
negative_and_recovery: Reject missing hashes, invalid status values, and forbidden sensitive paths.
Keep legal conclusions unknown when source evidence is absent.

deployment_steps: Push feature branch and private ledger branch.
Keep public PR in draft until checks and human review pass.
rollback_steps: Close the draft PR without merge; retain private evidence and Git history.
smoke_tests: Run Haruspex version and ledger validator.
monitoring: Review ledger after material contribution, disclosure, assignment, or release.
ownership: pxm-0 maintains records; counsel determines legal conclusions.

known_issues: Legal ownership and employment boundary remain unresolved pending private evidence and counsel review.
A second independently controlled backup cannot be verified from this workspace.
follow_ups: Review employment and invention-assignment documents with Philippine IP/employment counsel.
Copy the verified archive to a second independently controlled encrypted location.
notes: This task records evidence and controls; it does not determine legal ownership.
